scenes.h1: A female Quran teacher for your child?
scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Would you like a female Quran teacher for your child?
At Nurul Huda Academy, female teachers are available on request.

chips: Every teacher passes her recitation test
scenes.sub: Our Head of Academics is a Hafiza, and every teacher passes her recitation test.
Every class is live and one to one, with the Quran page on screen.
When you book the free trial, just choose "Female teacher" on the form.
Book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
